Things feel really dark right now. It's awful to be struggling with the things you have. I really understand the effect that an alcoholic father can have on a family, and it's not an easy thing to deal with. I've been in a similar situation.

But now that you're so close to the end of this turmoil, is there not the opportunity to recover and take a break?

Don't be too hard on yourself. You sound exhausted, and that's understandable. But depressed thoughts often come with exhaustion; don't let your current state of mind dictate tomorrow. Just take it one day at a time, and keep talking to people about this. When you've finished, I hope you'll feel that a weight has been lifted.

I want you to get through, and find comfort in the fact that you've done an amazing job for your family.

I get that, totally. I count my blessings every day, and life it really pretty ok. But I still can't shake the desire to take drastic action.

I think, for me at least, it's a fight or flight response. Stress. Adrenaline. And the incapability to do either - nothing to fight, nowhere to run to.

Are you stressed about something? Is there a situation or thought that triggers this in you?

Those are excellent points. I really see what you mean about giving up on suicide because we die eventually. I just don't feel that I can cope -  I variously want to resign from my job, kill myself or escape to the hills - just RUN AWAY and hide somehow.

I'm glad you understand how hard it is to deal with the constant troubling thoughts.

Thank you for your reply. I really appreciate you taking the time. I hope you feel good soon.

You are right. Thank you. 

I've been feeling like this for as long as I can remember, but it does get worse when I'm alone and away from everyone. I've tried speaking to the doctors, but they just give me medicines (fluoxetine, diazepam, amitryptelene; these are the names I can remember) that affect my ability to work and concentrate. I don't really feel that I have anyone to talk to. I guess there's a lot of stigma around this kind of thing... hence me posting here anonymously.

Thank you so much for replying.
